say:2:1321742001:1.text: This story mirrors Princess Yolena's life in so many ways... Lydia must have poured her heart into this, hoping it would comfort the princess.
say:2:1321742001:1.source_cn: 这个故事处处都和亚莲娜公主的遭遇很像……莉娅女士在准备...

say:3:1321742002:1.text: But sadly, Princess Yolena never got to see it...
say:3:1321742002:1.source_cn: 只可惜，亚莲娜公主没能亲眼见到……

say:4:1321742003:0.text: The princess has passed. Please, let's not linger in sorrow.
say:4:1321742003:0.source_cn: 公主殿下已逝，请各位不要再伤怀了。

say:5:1321742004:1.text: We must focus on crafting the <style="highlight">growth potion</style> and get out of here to find the princess' body. Only then can we preserve her final dignity.
say:5:1321742004:1.source_cn: 还是尽快<style=highlight>制出生长药水...

document:6:168:0.text:
Potion Name: Growth Potion
Instruction: <style="highlight">Use this potion on plants</style> to promote rapid growth.
Preparation: Prepare one portion of <style="highlight">stormflower</style> and <style="highlight">ivywood branch</style> each. Remove their petals and leaves, then simmer them in water until a green, bitter liquid forms.
document:6:168:0.source_cn:
药剂名：生长药水
使用说用：用于<style="highlight">浇灌植物</style>，可以令植物在短时间内快速生长。
制作方法：准备<style="highlight">雨润花</style>和<style="highlight">蔓彩枝</style>各一份，将花瓣和叶片分别取下，加入清水熬煮，直到形成绿色味苦液体。
